definitions.gloss: dwarf; little person; elf (in fairy tales)
definitions.explanation: A tiny human-like being in fairy tales and folklore: the seven dwarfs of Snow White, the elves of The Elves and the Shoemaker. Read こびと; the same kanji read しょうにん means a child (on ticket prices) and, read しょうじん, a petty person.

examples.japanese: {小人|こびと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧。
examples.english: A story with dwarfs in it.

examples.japanese: 『{白雪姫|しらゆきひめ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{七人|しちにん}→七人：30350_shichinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小人|こびと}』⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小人|こびと}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{童話|どうわ}→童話：04075_douwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a fairy tale in which little elves make shoes during the night.

notes:
Mostly a fairy-tale word. Using it for a real person of short stature is offensive and should be avoided.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {白雪姫|しらゆきひめ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{七人|しちにん}→七人：30350_shichinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小人|こびと}: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
- {小人|こびと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧: the land of the little people (as in Gulliver's Travels)

WATCH OUT:
- {小人|しょうにん} on fares and admission signs means "child": ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦{千円|せんえん}→千円：08980_senen⟧・{小人|しょうにん}{五百円|ごひゃくえん}.
- {小人|しょうじん} (literary) is a small-minded person, the opposite of {君子|くんし}.
